name: New Prahv
description: The Azorius Senate's towering guildhall, attacked during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

description_citations.text: "Tenth District". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Relov files an Application for Constant Protection on returning to New Prahv.
timeline.quote: As soon as Relov got back to New Prahv, he filled out an Application for Constant Protection.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Relov is turned to stone, and his statue is installed near the main gate and mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: No one looked long enough to see the uncanny resemblance to the missing Relov or the terror in his unblinking eyes.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and approving a new statue of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: Learn to spell, Mr. Lapt, and stop wasting my precious time.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Relov signs an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations when he sees the bribe amount.
timeline.quote: The request violated twelve statutes, but when Relov saw the pale pink number printed at the bottom, he signed without hesitation.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Relov receives a cryptic letter from Javy asking him to come, after a year of silence since she and her partner were attacked.
timeline.quote: What is the culmination of a life of words? Buckets of blood. Come now.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: After months of negotiation, Reza has solved the Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy with a fifty-seven page proposal.
timeline.quote: I'd solved the Fallacy. For real this time.

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Tagan tells Reza she can no longer be his mentor because it is time he becomes a mentor himself.
timeline.quote: I can't be your mentor anymore, because I think it's time you become a mentor yourself.

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexian invasion force against Ravnica, directing Realmbreaker at New Prahv and her old jail.
timeline.quote: first directing Realmbreaker toward the Azorius Senate's guild hall, New Prahv

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Nissa, Saheeli, Lavinia and Lazav shut off the Immortal Sun at New Prahv after defeating Dovin Baan, using Azor's nine words.
timeline.quote: Chandra managed to shut it off with the spell

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: New Prahv is severely damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion when Vraska directs Realmbreaker to attack the Azorius guild hall and jail.
timeline.quote: New Prahv was severely damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Phyrexian Invasion and Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: New Prahv is built once popular support grows and Isperia accepts leadership of the guild.
timeline.quote: Only once popular support built up and Isperia accepted the leadership of the guild did the gears of reconstruction begin to turn.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "New Prahv, the Azorius Guildhall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies the sphinx Isperia at the guild summit, shattering hopes for cooperation.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Guild summit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexian invasion force against Ravnica, directing Realmbreaker at New Prahv.
timeline.quote: Vraska led the Phyrexian invasion force against her home plane

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Vraska leads the Phyrexian force to attack New Prahv and the Undercity.
timeline.quote: Vraska led the Phyrexian force into the Tenth District, attacking New Prahv and parts of the Undercity , raising them into sunlight for the first time in centuries.

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
